intrinsically motivated goal exploration and unsu-pervised learning of goal representations are promising approaches for the discovery of diverse selforganized patterns in complex dynamical systems.

intrinsically motivated goal exploration can be used for discovering diverse patterns in self-organizing systems, that goal representation learning is crucial for this purpose, and that deep neural networks can be used for goal representation learning in this application domain.

intrinsically motivated goal exploration can be used as a general-purpose tool for automated discovery of self-organized spatially localized patterns in high-dimensional dynamical systems.
